source.notes: Word-processed school assessment paper with a real text layer (letters of the diagonal 'Downloaded From www.icseboard.org' watermark are interleaved in the text layer and were removed). Header printed: 'GRADE-VII  SCHOOL  MATHMATICS / TIME 2 HOURS  ASSESSMENT - II  M.M. 40' (spelling 'MATHMATICS' as printed; 'SCHOOL' stands in for the school name). No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2023 is taken from the file name and its icseboard.org folder (…/mathematics/2023/). Section A (20 MARKS, attempt all): Q.I [10] ten MCQs (1 mark each), Q.II [5] five blanks (1 each), Q.III [2] four True/False items (kept as one entry because the 2 marks cannot be split into whole marks per item), Q.IV [3] three bar-graph items (1 each). Section B (20 Marks, 'Attempt any 4 questions') has seven questions Q.I-Q.VII, so each is worth 5 marks by the section instructions; the split between their parts a) and b) is not printed, so each Section B question is one entry with both parts. Section B restarts the numbering at Q.I, so its entries use numbers 'B-I' … 'B-VII' to keep them distinct from Section A. Marks in this file total 55 (20 + 7 x 5) against the printed 40 because of the pick-4-of-7 choice. No answer key.
